title: How often should you train each muscle? 📅
caption:
Hitting each muscle at least twice a week tends to beat once, but when total weekly sets are equal, frequency matters much less. Pick the split you will stick to. Bro split or full body? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 13
sources: Schoenfeld BJ, Ogborn D, Krieger JW. Effects of resistance training frequency on measures of muscle hypertrophy: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Sports Med 2016;46:1689-1697
Schoenfeld BJ, Grgic J, Krieger J. How many times per week should a muscle be trained to maximize muscle hypertrophy? J Sports Sci 2019;37:1286-1295
Grgic J et al. Effect of resistance training frequency on gains in muscular strength: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Sports Med 2018;48:1207-1220
